Updated `Parameter.get_error_hint` with keyword-only `include_secondary: bool = False`. When enabled, secondary options follow primary options; default behavior, fallback, and quoting are preserved.

Only `src/click/core.py` changed. No untracked files remain.

arguments.command:
$env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'; $env:PYTHONPATH='src'; @'
import click
from click.core import Parameter
ctx = click.Context(click.Command('test'))
p = click.Option(['--enabled/--disabled'])
assert p.get_error_hint(ctx) == "'--enabled'"
assert p.get_error_hint(ctx, include_secondary=True) == "'--enabled' / '--disabled'"
assert p.opts == ['--enabled'] and p.secondary_opts == ['--disabled']
p = click.Option(['--name', '-n'])
assert p.get_error_hint(ctx) == p.get_error_hint(ctx, include_secondary=True) == "'--name' / '-n'"
p = Parameter(['name'])
assert p.get_error_hint(ctx) == p.get_error_hint(ctx, include_secondary=True) == "'name'"
p.secondary_opts = ['--secondary']
assert p.get_error_hint(ctx) == "'name'"
assert p.get_error_hint(ctx, include_secondary=True) == "'--secondary'"
try:
    p.get_error_hint(ctx, True)
except TypeError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('include_secondary must be keyword-only')

import click
from click.core import Parameter
ctx = click.Context(click.Command('test'))
for p, expected in [(click.Option(['--enabled/--disabled']), "'--enabled' / '--disabled'"), (click.Option(['--name', '-n']), "'--name' / '-n'")]:
    original = p.opts[:]
    assert p.get_error_hint(ctx) == ' / '.join(repr(x) for x in original)
    assert p.get_error_hint(ctx, include_secondary=True) == expected
    assert p.opts == original
p = click.Argument(['name'])
p.opts = []
p.secondary_opts = []
fallback = repr(p.human_readable_name)
assert Parameter.get_error_hint(p, ctx) == fallback
assert Parameter.get_error_hint(p, ctx, include_secondary=True) == fallback
p.secondary_opts = ['--secondary']
assert Parameter.get_error_hint(p, ctx) == fallback
assert Parameter.get_error_hint(p, ctx, include_secondary=True) == "'--secondary'"
try:
    Parameter.get_error_hint(p, ctx, True)
except TypeError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('include_secondary must be keyword-only')
